title: LangChoiceBench: Measuring and Explaining Programming-Language Choice in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.06041v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been shown to exhibit strong Python preferences when generating project-level code, but there is currently no systematic way to measure this behaviour across new models. To bridge this gap, we introduce LangChoiceBench, a project-level code-generation benchmark for measuring Python preference, recommendation-implementation consistency, and language diversity. LangChoiceBench covers 28 projects across seven software areas where Python is often a poor default. We evaluate 25 diverse LLMs and find that Python remains heavily over-selected, recommendation-implementation consistency is low, and smaller open-weight models generally show stronger Python preference and lower language diversity. We further analyse 9,826 reasoning traces and find that most Python choices are automatic or driven primarily by ease, rather than explicit consideration of project requirements. translated_title: LangChoiceBench：测量与解释大语言模型中的编程语言选择
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在生成项目级代码时已被证明对Python表现出强烈的偏好，但目前尚无系统性的方法来在新模型中测量这种行为。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了LangChoiceBench，这是一个项目级代码生成基准，用于测量Python偏好、推荐与实现的一致性以及语言多样性。LangChoiceBench涵盖七个软件领域中的28个项目，这些领域中Python往往不是一个好的默认选择。我们评估了25个多样化的LLM，发现Python仍被严重过度选用，推荐与实现之间的一致性较低，且较小的开放权重模型通常表现出更强的Python偏好和更低的语言多样性。我们进一步分析了9,826条推理轨迹，发现大多数Python选择是自动做出的或主要由易用性驱动，而非对项目需求的明确考量。在一组较小但重要的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了LangChoiceBench基准，系统测量25个大语言模型在28个项目中的编程语言选择行为，发现模型普遍过度偏好Python且多为未经深思熟虑的自动选择，较小的开放权重模型偏好更强、语言多样性更低。
en_tdlr: Introduces LangChoiceBench, a project-level code-generation benchmark that reveals LLMs heavily over-select Python—often automatically or driven by ease rather than by explicit consideration of project requirements—with smaller open-weight models showing the strongest bias and lowest language diversity.
